strategy.relationship: Semantic tokens consume or reference brand tokens where appropriate, but remain EduSDK interface decisions.

color.source: Observed EduSDK light and dark backgrounds
color.rationale: Keeps the two observed interface modes while reducing them to a light institutional theme and a dark operational theme.
Normalizes card and panel surfaces for both themes.

color.source: Observed elevated dark surfaces and light cards
color.rationale: Supports raised cards, sticky bars or active surfaces without creating a third visual system.

color.source: Observed during curso heredado postmigration in portal, Profesor Plus, exam and blocks
color.rationale: Provides a low-emphasis surface for secondary navigation, sidebars, compact cards and icon slots. This is an EduSDK interface decision, not an official brand token.
Meets WCAG AA for normal text in both themes.
Preserves existing hierarchy while keeping normal text contrast acceptable.

color.source: Observed light card borders and dark exam borders
color.rationale: Defines a subtle default border for cards, panels and controls.

color.source: Brand green tokens, adjusted by theme for contrast
color.rationale: Uses brand greens as the main interface accent where contrast is viable.

color.source: Derived interface hover colors from accent
color.rationale: Provides a perceptible hover step without introducing another brand color.

color.source: Observed during curso heredado postmigration in portal, Profesor Plus, exam and blocks
color.rationale: Supports soft hover, selected and active states, gentle alerts and icon emphasis without using a solid accent fill. This is an EduSDK interface decision, not an official brand token.
Defines readable text when a component uses the accent as a filled surface.

color.source: Derived from brand blue/yellow families for visible focus rings
color.rationale: Focus must be clearly perceptible and not rely on existing accent alone.

color.source: Observed during curso heredado postmigration in portal, Profesor Plus, exam and blocks
color.rationale: Keeps search, form and filter controls legible in both themes without relying on local fallbacks. This is an EduSDK interface decision, not an official brand token.

color.source: Brand green tokens plus existing correct feedback pattern
color.rationale: Explicit EduSDK decision for positive feedback; components must also use text, icon or shape.

color.source: Derived accessible warning for light theme and brand yellow for dark theme
color.rationale: Avoids low-contrast yellow text on light surfaces while keeping brand-compatible yellow in dark UI.

color.source: Brand red for light theme and existing high-contrast dark error color
color.rationale: Danger is an EduSDK state decision, not a direct identity rule; dark value preserves current exam readability.

color.source: Brand blue family adapted by theme
color.rationale: Uses the blue-green brand family for informational emphasis without making it the main accent.

typography.source: Observed in exam and Profesor Plus
typography.rationale: Inter/system stack supports long-form UI reading without depending on brand fonts.

typography.source: Observed in exam and Profesor Plus
typography.rationale: Keeps headings aligned with body UI typography until a web font decision is made.
Uses inherited UI font for controls, chips and labels.

typography.source: Manual de Identidad Corporativa Red Circular FAB
typography.rationale: Documented brand document typeface; availability is not guaranteed by these tokens.

typography.source: Manual de Identidad Corporativa Red Circular FAB
typography.rationale: Documented brand accent typeface; availability is not guaranteed by these tokens.

space.source: Observed gaps, bars and compact controls
Most common grid gap and mobile padding
Observed large cards and hero panels

radius.source: Observed mode cards and dark base cards

shadow.source: Observed during curso heredado postmigration in portal, Profesor Plus, exam and blocks
shadow.rationale: Provides a low-hierarchy elevation for compact cards, topbars and small raised elements. This is an EduSDK interface decision, not an official brand token.

shadow.source: Observed Profesor Plus and exam elevated panels
shadow.rationale: Single reusable raised shadow; components may disable or soften it in print or flat light contexts.

accessibility.target: WCAG AA for normal text where semantic colors are used for text
accessibility.rule: Correct, incorrect, warning and focus states must not rely on color alone. Components should add text, icon, border, shape, or an equivalent redundant cue.
